'''Misato Fukuen''' (Japanese: '''福圓美里''' ''Fukuen Misato'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Fukuen was born as '''Misato Sakuragi''' (桜木美里 ''Sakuragi Misato'') on January 10, 1982 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She joined the cast of the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, voicing [[Ash's Oshawott]] and {{an|Iris}}'s [[rival]] [[Georgia]]. Fukuen is currently affiliated with {{wp|Sigma Seven}} and is known as '''MIRI''' in her singing career.
